seg.abda31761e23.src: Plain answers to what buyers ask us, starting with how to check turmeric powder at home.
seg.abda31761e23.t: ᱠᱤᱨᱤᱧ ᱦᱚᱲ ᱡᱟᱦᱟᱸ ᱠᱚ ᱠᱩᱠᱞᱤ ᱞᱮᱜᱼᱟ, ᱚᱱᱟ ᱨᱮᱭᱟᱜ ᱥᱚᱡᱦᱮ ᱛᱮᱞᱟ, ᱮᱦᱚᱵ ᱨᱮ: ᱚᱲᱟᱜ ᱨᱮ ᱥᱟᱥᱟᱝ ᱦᱚᱞᱚᱝ ᱪᱮᱫ ᱞᱮᱠᱟ ᱧᱮᱞ ᱞᱟᱹᱠᱛᱤᱭᱟ᱾
seg.abda31761e23.back: Simple answers to what buying people ask us, at the start: how turmeric powder should be checked at home.

seg.2b6b229e651e.src: FSSAI's standard says turmeric powder must be free from added colouring matter, including lead chromate, and from foreign starch. Its testing manual lists what inspectors check turmeric for: added dyes such as metanil yellow, lead salts, and chalk powder.
seg.2b6b229e651e.t: FSSAI ᱨᱮᱭᱟᱜ ᱢᱟᱱᱚᱠ ᱞᱮᱠᱟᱛᱮ ᱥᱟᱥᱟᱝ ᱦᱚᱞᱚᱝ ᱨᱮ ᱥᱮᱞᱮᱫ ᱨᱚᱝ, ᱞᱮᱰ ᱠᱨᱚᱢᱮᱴ ᱥᱟᱶ, ᱟᱨ ᱵᱟᱦᱨᱮ ᱨᱮᱭᱟᱜ ᱥᱴᱟᱨᱪ ᱵᱟᱝ ᱛᱟᱦᱮᱸ ᱞᱟᱹᱠᱛᱤᱭᱟ᱾ ᱚᱱᱟᱨᱮᱭᱟᱜ ᱧᱮᱞ ᱯᱚᱛᱚᱵ ᱨᱮ ᱚᱞ ᱢᱮᱱᱟᱜᱼᱟ ᱤᱱᱥᱯᱮᱠᱴᱚᱨ ᱥᱟᱥᱟᱝ ᱨᱮ ᱪᱮᱫ ᱠᱚ ᱧᱮᱞᱟ: ᱥᱮᱞᱮᱫ ᱨᱚᱝ ᱡᱮᱞᱮᱠᱟ ᱢᱮᱴᱟᱱᱤᱞ ᱤᱭᱮᱞᱚ, ᱞᱮᱰ ᱵᱩᱞᱩᱝ, ᱟᱨ ᱪᱚᱠ ᱦᱚᱞᱚᱝ᱾
seg.2b6b229e651e.back: According to FSSAI's standard there should not be added colour, with lead chromate, and outside starch in turmeric powder. In its check book it is written what inspectors look for in turmeric: added colours like metanil yellow, lead salts, and chalk powder.

seg.b27088069a9d.src: Some of this you can check in your kitchen, and some only a lab can find. This guide covers both, plus two popular tests that do not work for turmeric. Try them on any turmeric you buy, ours included.
seg.b27088069a9d.t: ᱱᱚᱶᱟ ᱠᱷᱚᱱ ᱛᱤᱱᱟᱹᱜ ᱟᱢ ᱡᱚᱢᱟᱜ ᱵᱮᱱᱟᱣ ᱚᱲᱟᱜ ᱨᱮ ᱧᱮᱞ ᱫᱟᱲᱮᱭᱟᱜᱼᱟᱢ, ᱟᱨ ᱛᱤᱱᱟᱹᱜ ᱞᱮᱵ ᱜᱮ ᱥᱮᱸᱫᱽᱨᱟ ᱫᱟᱲᱮᱭᱟᱜᱼᱟ᱾ ᱱᱚᱶᱟ ᱞᱟᱹᱭ ᱥᱚᱫᱚᱨ ᱵᱟᱨᱭᱟ ᱵᱟᱵᱚᱛ ᱞᱟᱹᱭᱟ, ᱟᱨ ᱵᱟᱨᱴᱟ ᱧᱩᱛᱩᱢ ᱴᱮᱥᱴ ᱵᱟᱵᱚᱛ ᱦᱚᱸ ᱡᱟᱦᱟᱸ ᱥᱟᱥᱟᱝ ᱨᱮ ᱵᱟᱝ ᱠᱟᱹᱢᱤᱭᱟ᱾ ᱡᱟᱦᱟᱸ ᱥᱟᱥᱟᱝ ᱜᱮ ᱠᱤᱨᱤᱧ ᱢᱮ ᱚᱱᱟ ᱨᱮ ᱧᱮᱞ ᱢᱮ, ᱟᱞᱮᱭᱟᱜ ᱦᱚᱸ᱾
seg.b27088069a9d.back: Of this you can check some in the kitchen, and some only a lab can find. This guidance tells about both, and also about two named (well-known) tests which do not work on turmeric. Check it on whatever turmeric you buy, ours too.

seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.src: Two glasses of water after the turmeric check. Left: pale yellow water with the powder settled at the bottom. Right: strong yellow water with yellow trails running down from the powder.
seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.t: ᱥᱟᱥᱟᱝ ᱧᱮᱞ ᱛᱟᱭᱚᱢ ᱵᱟᱨᱴᱟ ᱜᱞᱟᱥ ᱫᱟᱜ᱾ ᱞᱮᱸᱜᱟ: ᱯᱷᱤᱠᱟ ᱯᱤᱭᱚᱨ ᱫᱟᱜ ᱟᱨ ᱦᱚᱞᱚᱝ ᱞᱟᱛᱟᱨ ᱨᱮ ᱫᱩᱵ ᱟᱠᱟᱱ᱾ ᱡᱚᱡᱚᱢ: ᱜᱟᱲᱦᱟ ᱯᱤᱭᱚᱨ ᱫᱟᱜ ᱟᱨ ᱦᱚᱞᱚᱝ ᱠᱷᱚᱱ ᱞᱟᱛᱟᱨ ᱥᱮᱱ ᱯᱤᱭᱚᱨ ᱫᱟᱜ ᱠᱚ᱾
seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.back: Two glasses of water after the turmeric check. Left: pale yellow water and powder settled at the bottom. Right: deep yellow water and yellow water streaks going down from the powder.

seg.c8b6eb5f9530.src: ⟦1⟧The water check⟦/1⟧Left: the powder has settled and the water is pale yellow. Right: strong yellow trails ran from the powder as it sank, and the water turned deep yellow. That one is worth a lab test.
seg.c8b6eb5f9530.t: ⟦1⟧ᱫᱟᱜ ᱧᱮᱞ⟦/1⟧ᱞᱮᱸᱜᱟ: ᱦᱚᱞᱚᱝ ᱞᱟᱛᱟᱨ ᱫᱩᱵ ᱮᱱᱟ ᱟᱨ ᱫᱟᱜ ᱯᱷᱤᱠᱟ ᱯᱤᱭᱚᱨ᱾ ᱡᱚᱡᱚᱢ: ᱦᱚᱞᱚᱝ ᱞᱟᱛᱟᱨ ᱥᱮᱱ ᱚᱠᱛᱚ ᱚᱱᱟ ᱠᱷᱚᱱ ᱜᱟᱲᱦᱟ ᱯᱤᱭᱚᱨ ᱫᱟᱜ ᱠᱚ ᱫᱟᱹᱲ ᱮᱱᱟ, ᱟᱨ ᱫᱟᱜ ᱜᱟᱲᱦᱟ ᱯᱤᱭᱚᱨ ᱦᱩᱭ ᱮᱱᱟ᱾ ᱚᱱᱟ ᱫᱚ ᱞᱮᱵ ᱛᱮ ᱧᱮᱞ ᱞᱟᱹᱠᱛᱤᱭᱟ᱾
seg.c8b6eb5f9530.back: ⟦1⟧The water check⟦/1⟧Left: the powder settled at the bottom and the water is pale yellow. Right: while the powder went down deep yellow water streaks ran from it, and the water became deep yellow. That should be checked by a lab.

seg.a7363cc3fa37.src: Sprinkle a teaspoon of turmeric on a glass of water and let it settle without stirring. Turmeric sinks and leaves the water pale yellow; water that turns strong yellow straight away points to added colour. This check cannot find lead chromate or chalk, so for a sure answer, use a food testing lab. Skip the iodine test: turmeric is starchy to begin with.
seg.a7363cc3fa37.t: ᱢᱤᱫ ᱜᱞᱟᱥ ᱫᱟᱜ ᱪᱮᱛᱟᱱ ᱨᱮ ᱢᱤᱫ ᱦᱩᱰᱤᱧ ᱪᱟᱢᱚᱪ ᱥᱟᱥᱟᱝ ᱪᱤᱴᱟᱹ ᱢᱮ ᱟᱨ ᱜᱷᱟᱱᱴᱟ ᱵᱮᱜᱚᱨ ᱫᱩᱵ ᱮᱢ ᱢᱮ᱾ ᱥᱟᱥᱟᱝ ᱞᱟᱛᱟᱨ ᱥᱮᱱᱚᱜᱼᱟ ᱟᱨ ᱫᱟᱜ ᱯᱷᱤᱠᱟ ᱯᱤᱭᱚᱨ ᱛᱟᱦᱮᱸᱱᱟ; ᱡᱩᱫᱤ ᱫᱟᱜ ᱛᱩᱨᱩᱛ ᱜᱟᱲᱦᱟ ᱯᱤᱭᱚᱨ ᱦᱩᱭᱩᱜ ᱠᱷᱟᱱ ᱚᱱᱟ ᱥᱮᱞᱮᱫ ᱨᱚᱝ ᱥᱮᱫ ᱩᱫᱩᱜᱼᱟ᱾ ᱱᱚᱶᱟ ᱧᱮᱞ ᱛᱮ ᱞᱮᱰ ᱠᱨᱚᱢᱮᱴ ᱥᱮ ᱪᱚᱠ ᱵᱟᱝ ᱥᱮᱸᱫᱽᱨᱟ ᱫᱟᱲᱮᱭᱟᱜᱼᱟ, ᱚᱱᱟᱛᱮ ᱯᱟᱠᱟ ᱛᱮᱞᱟ ᱞᱟᱹᱜᱤᱫ ᱡᱚᱢᱟᱜ ᱧᱮᱞ ᱞᱮᱵ ᱛᱮ ᱪᱟᱞᱟᱜ ᱢᱮ᱾ ᱟᱭᱳᱰᱤᱱ ᱴᱮᱥᱴ ᱟᱲᱟᱜ ᱢᱮ: ᱥᱟᱥᱟᱝ ᱨᱮ ᱟᱡ ᱛᱮᱜᱮ ᱥᱴᱟᱨᱪ ᱢᱮᱱᱟᱜᱼᱟ᱾
seg.a7363cc3fa37.back: On top of one glass of water sprinkle one small spoon of turmeric and let it settle without stirring. Turmeric goes to the bottom and the water stays pale yellow; if the water immediately becomes deep yellow it shows added colour. With this check lead chromate or chalk cannot be found, so for a sure answer go to a food check lab. Leave out the iodine test: turmeric itself has starch.

seg.34d6f989bfaf.src: Such as metanil yellow, which can make dull turmeric look brighter. FSSAI does not allow added colour in turmeric.
seg.34d6f989bfaf.t: ᱡᱮᱞᱮᱠᱟ ᱢᱮᱴᱟᱱᱤᱞ ᱤᱭᱮᱞᱚ, ᱡᱟᱦᱟᱸ ᱯᱷᱤᱠᱟ ᱥᱟᱥᱟᱝ ᱟᱨᱦᱚᱸ ᱢᱮᱨᱚᱢ ᱧᱮᱞᱚᱜ ᱫᱟᱲᱮᱭᱟᱜᱼᱟ᱾ FSSAI ᱥᱟᱥᱟᱝ ᱨᱮ ᱥᱮᱞᱮᱫ ᱨᱚᱝ ᱵᱟᱝ ᱦᱩᱠᱩᱢ ᱮᱢᱟᱭᱟ᱾
seg.34d6f989bfaf.back: Like metanil yellow, which can make pale turmeric look more bright. FSSAI does not give permission for added colour in turmeric.

seg.042cabe54b01.src: Lead chromate and other lead salts
seg.042cabe54b01.t: ᱞᱮᱰ ᱠᱨᱚᱢᱮᱴ ᱟᱨ ᱮᱴᱟᱜ ᱞᱮᱰ ᱵᱩᱞᱩᱝ
seg.042cabe54b01.back: Lead chromate and other lead salts

seg.8310b11eab8b.src: Lead chromate is a yellow pigment used in paint. Stanford-led studies published in 2019 and 2024 found it in turmeric from parts of South Asia. FSSAI does not allow it in turmeric at all.
seg.8310b11eab8b.t: ᱞᱮᱰ ᱠᱨᱚᱢᱮᱴ ᱫᱚ ᱨᱚᱝ (ᱯᱮᱱᱴ) ᱨᱮ ᱵᱮᱵᱷᱟᱨᱚᱜ ᱢᱤᱫᱴᱟᱝ ᱯᱤᱭᱚᱨ ᱨᱚᱝ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ᱾ Stanford ᱟᱜᱩᱣᱟᱹᱭ ᱛᱮ 2019 ᱟᱨ 2024 ᱨᱮ ᱪᱷᱟᱯᱟ ᱥᱮᱸᱫᱽᱨᱟ ᱠᱚ ᱫᱚᱠᱷᱤᱱ ᱮᱥᱤᱭᱟ ᱨᱮᱭᱟᱜ ᱛᱤᱱᱟᱹᱜ ᱴᱷᱟᱶ ᱨᱮᱭᱟᱜ ᱥᱟᱥᱟᱝ ᱨᱮ ᱚᱱᱟ ᱧᱟᱢ ᱞᱮᱫᱟ᱾ FSSAI ᱥᱟᱥᱟᱝ ᱨᱮ ᱚᱱᱟ ᱡᱚᱛᱚᱫᱚ ᱵᱟᱝ ᱦᱩᱠᱩᱢ ᱮᱢᱟᱭᱟ᱾
seg.8310b11eab8b.back: Lead chromate is a yellow colour used in colour (paint). Research printed in 2019 and 2024 under Stanford's leadership found it in turmeric of some places of South Asia. FSSAI does not give permission for it in turmeric at all.

seg.4278e7c5416c.src: A cheap white powder that adds weight.
seg.4278e7c5416c.t: ᱢᱤᱫᱴᱟᱝ ᱥᱚᱥᱛᱟ ᱯᱩᱸᱰ ᱦᱚᱞᱚᱝ ᱡᱟᱦᱟᱸ ᱵᱚᱡᱚᱱ ᱵᱟᱹᱲᱛᱤᱭᱟ᱾
seg.4278e7c5416c.back: A cheap white powder which increases weight.

seg.5a8b446bbce0.src: Flour or starch from other crops. FSSAI's standard rules it out too.
seg.5a8b446bbce0.t: ᱮᱴᱟᱜ ᱡᱟᱹᱱᱤᱡ ᱨᱮᱭᱟᱜ ᱟᱴᱟ ᱥᱮ ᱥᱴᱟᱨᱪ᱾ FSSAI ᱨᱮᱭᱟᱜ ᱢᱟᱱᱚᱠ ᱚᱱᱟ ᱦᱚᱸ ᱵᱟᱝ ᱦᱩᱠᱩᱢ ᱮᱢᱟᱭᱟ᱾
seg.5a8b446bbce0.back: Flour or starch of other grain. FSSAI's standard also does not give permission for that.

seg.1b1af7f63ffd.src: Fill a clear glass with water at room temperature.
seg.1b1af7f63ffd.t: ᱢᱤᱫᱴᱟᱝ ᱯᱷᱟᱨᱪᱟᱹ ᱜᱞᱟᱥ ᱠᱚᱴᱷᱨᱤ ᱞᱚᱞᱚ ᱫᱟᱜ ᱛᱮ ᱯᱮᱨᱮᱡ ᱢᱮ᱾
seg.1b1af7f63ffd.back: Fill a clean glass with room-warm water.

seg.653731f2ed6f.src: Sprinkle one level teaspoon of turmeric powder on top. Do not stir.
seg.653731f2ed6f.t: ᱪᱮᱛᱟᱱ ᱨᱮ ᱢᱤᱫ ᱥᱚᱢᱟᱱ ᱦᱩᱰᱤᱧ ᱪᱟᱢᱚᱪ ᱥᱟᱥᱟᱝ ᱦᱚᱞᱚᱝ ᱪᱤᱴᱟᱹ ᱢᱮ᱾ ᱟᱞᱚᱢ ᱜᱷᱟᱱᱴᱟᱭᱟ᱾
seg.653731f2ed6f.back: On top sprinkle one level small spoon of turmeric powder. Do not stir.

seg.ea5b43cf8436.src: Watch the first minute as the powder sinks. Look for coloured trails running down from it.
seg.ea5b43cf8436.t: ᱦᱚᱞᱚᱝ ᱞᱟᱛᱟᱨ ᱥᱮᱱᱚᱜ ᱚᱠᱛᱚ ᱯᱩᱭᱞᱩ ᱢᱤᱱᱤᱴ ᱧᱮᱞ ᱢᱮ᱾ ᱚᱱᱟ ᱠᱷᱚᱱ ᱞᱟᱛᱟᱨ ᱥᱮᱱᱚᱜ ᱨᱚᱝ ᱫᱟᱜ ᱠᱚ ᱧᱮᱞ ᱢᱮ᱾
seg.ea5b43cf8436.back: Watch the first minute while the powder goes to the bottom. Look at the coloured water streaks going down from it.

seg.e37698aaa3fb.src: Leave it for 15 to 20 minutes. Then hold the glass against a white wall or a sheet of paper and look at the water above the settled powder.
seg.e37698aaa3fb.t: 15 ᱠᱷᱚᱱ 20 ᱢᱤᱱᱤᱴ ᱫᱚᱦᱚ ᱢᱮ᱾ ᱛᱟᱭᱚᱢ ᱜᱞᱟᱥ ᱯᱩᱸᱰ ᱵᱟᱸᱫᱷ ᱥᱮ ᱠᱟᱜᱚᱡ ᱥᱚᱢᱟᱝ ᱨᱮ ᱥᱟᱵ ᱠᱟᱛᱮ ᱫᱩᱵ ᱟᱠᱟᱱ ᱦᱚᱞᱚᱝ ᱪᱮᱛᱟᱱ ᱨᱮᱭᱟᱜ ᱫᱟᱜ ᱧᱮᱞ ᱢᱮ᱾
seg.e37698aaa3fb.back: Leave it 15 to 20 minutes. Then holding the glass in front of a white wall or paper look at the water above the settled powder.

seg.e8937cebf136.src: Pale yellow water, powder at the bottom
seg.e8937cebf136.t: ᱯᱷᱤᱠᱟ ᱯᱤᱭᱚᱨ ᱫᱟᱜ, ᱦᱚᱞᱚᱝ ᱞᱟᱛᱟᱨ ᱨᱮ
seg.e8937cebf136.back: Pale yellow water, powder at the bottom

seg.7253b4d90896.t: ᱥᱮᱞᱮᱫ ᱨᱚᱝ ᱨᱮᱭᱟᱜ ᱡᱟᱦᱟᱱ ᱪᱤᱱᱦᱟᱹ ᱵᱟᱹᱱᱩᱜᱼᱟ᱾
seg.7253b4d90896.back: There is no sign of added colour.

seg.256ce5cf303d.src: Strong yellow trails, or deep yellow water within minutes
seg.256ce5cf303d.t: ᱜᱟᱲᱦᱟ ᱯᱤᱭᱚᱨ ᱫᱟᱜ ᱠᱚ, ᱥᱮ ᱢᱤᱱᱤᱴ ᱵᱷᱤᱛᱤᱨ ᱜᱟᱲᱦᱟ ᱯᱤᱭᱚᱨ ᱫᱟᱜ
seg.256ce5cf303d.back: Deep yellow water streaks, or deep yellow water within minutes

seg.ce06c8148072.src: Possible added colour. Stop using that batch and get it tested.
seg.ce06c8148072.t: ᱥᱮᱞᱮᱫ ᱨᱚᱝ ᱛᱟᱦᱮᱸ ᱫᱟᱲᱮᱭᱟᱜᱼᱟ᱾ ᱚᱱᱟ ᱵᱮᱪ ᱵᱮᱵᱷᱟᱨ ᱵᱚᱸᱫ ᱢᱮ ᱟᱨ ᱚᱱᱟ ᱧᱮᱞ ᱦᱚᱪᱚ ᱢᱮ᱾
seg.ce06c8148072.back: There may be added colour. Stop using that batch and get it checked.

seg.53d9c5db264d.src: ⟦1⟧Why it works.⟦/1⟧ Turmeric's own yellow, curcumin, hardly dissolves in water, so the powder sinks and only tints the water. Dyes such as metanil yellow dissolve easily and colour the water fast.
seg.53d9c5db264d.t: ⟦1⟧ᱱᱚᱶᱟ ᱪᱮᱫᱟᱜ ᱠᱟᱹᱢᱤᱭᱟ᱾⟦/1⟧ ᱥᱟᱥᱟᱝ ᱨᱮᱭᱟᱜ ᱟᱡᱟᱜ ᱯᱤᱭᱚᱨ ᱨᱚᱝ, ᱠᱟᱨᱠᱩᱢᱤᱱ, ᱫᱟᱜ ᱨᱮ ᱟᱹᱰᱤ ᱠᱚᱢ ᱞᱤᱞᱤᱭᱚᱜᱼᱟ, ᱚᱱᱟᱛᱮ ᱦᱚᱞᱚᱝ ᱫᱩᱵᱚᱜᱼᱟ ᱟᱨ ᱫᱟᱜ ᱦᱩᱰᱤᱧ ᱜᱮ ᱨᱚᱝᱚᱜᱼᱟ᱾ ᱢᱮᱴᱟᱱᱤᱞ ᱤᱭᱮᱞᱚ ᱞᱮᱠᱟᱱ ᱨᱚᱝ ᱟᱞᱜᱟ ᱛᱮ ᱞᱤᱞᱤᱭᱚᱜᱼᱟ ᱟᱨ ᱫᱟᱜ ᱞᱚᱜᱚᱱ ᱨᱚᱝᱟ᱾
seg.53d9c5db264d.back: ⟦1⟧Why this works.⟦/1⟧ Turmeric's own yellow colour, curcumin, dissolves very little in water, so the powder sinks and the water gets coloured only a little. Colours like metanil yellow dissolve easily and colour the water quickly.

seg.af4442c6e910.src: ⟦1⟧What it misses.⟦/1⟧ Lead chromate and chalk do not dissolve in water either, so turmeric mixed with them can pass this check. Only a lab test can rule them out.
seg.af4442c6e910.t: ⟦1⟧ᱱᱚᱶᱟ ᱪᱮᱫ ᱵᱟᱝ ᱥᱮᱸᱫᱽᱨᱟ ᱫᱟᱲᱮᱭᱟᱜᱼᱟ᱾⟦/1⟧ ᱞᱮᱰ ᱠᱨᱚᱢᱮᱴ ᱟᱨ ᱪᱚᱠ ᱦᱚᱸ ᱫᱟᱜ ᱨᱮ ᱵᱟᱝ ᱞᱤᱞᱤᱭᱚᱜᱼᱟ, ᱚᱱᱟᱛᱮ ᱚᱱᱟ ᱠᱚ ᱢᱤᱥᱟᱹᱣ ᱟᱠᱟᱱ ᱥᱟᱥᱟᱝ ᱱᱚᱶᱟ ᱧᱮᱞ ᱨᱮ ᱯᱟᱥ ᱫᱟᱲᱮᱭᱟᱜᱼᱟ᱾ ᱞᱮᱵ ᱴᱮᱥᱴ ᱜᱮ ᱚᱱᱟ ᱠᱚ ᱵᱟᱹᱱᱩᱜ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ ᱢᱮᱱᱛᱮ ᱞᱟᱹᱭ ᱫᱟᱲᱮᱭᱟᱜᱼᱟ᱾
seg.af4442c6e910.back: ⟦1⟧What this cannot find.⟦/1⟧ Lead chromate and chalk also do not dissolve in water, so turmeric mixed with them can pass this check. Only a lab test can tell that they are absent.

seg.a8b61850b87d.src: Very fine powder can keep the water cloudy for a while. Cloudy is fine; a clear, strong yellow is what to look for.
seg.a8b61850b87d.t: ᱟᱹᱰᱤ ᱵᱟᱨᱤᱠ ᱦᱚᱞᱚᱝ ᱛᱮ ᱫᱟᱜ ᱛᱤᱱᱟᱹᱜ ᱚᱠᱛᱚ ᱫᱷᱩᱞᱤ ᱞᱮᱠᱟᱱ ᱛᱟᱦᱮᱸ ᱫᱟᱲᱮᱭᱟᱜᱼᱟ᱾ ᱫᱷᱩᱞᱤ ᱞᱮᱠᱟᱱ ᱫᱚ ᱴᱷᱤᱠ ᱜᱮ; ᱯᱷᱟᱨᱪᱟᱹ, ᱜᱟᱲᱦᱟ ᱯᱤᱭᱚᱨ ᱨᱚᱝ ᱜᱮ ᱧᱮᱞ ᱞᱟᱹᱠᱛᱤᱭᱟ᱾
seg.a8b61850b87d.back: With very fine powder the water can stay dust-like (cloudy) for some time. Dust-like is fine; a clean, deep yellow colour is what should be looked for.

seg.c3455d1f4c96.src: Check 2: if you buy whole turmeric
seg.c3455d1f4c96.t: ᱧᱮᱞ 2: ᱡᱩᱫᱤ ᱥᱟᱵᱩᱛ ᱥᱟᱥᱟᱝ ᱠᱤᱨᱤᱧ ᱢᱮ
seg.c3455d1f4c96.back: Check 2: if you buy whole turmeric

seg.3d4e366bb488.src: Snap a finger of dried turmeric in half. Turmeric is yellow-orange right through, so the inside should look much like the outside. A bright yellow skin over a pale or dull core can mean colour was added to the surface. Ask the seller about it, or get it tested.
seg.3d4e366bb488.t: ᱨᱚᱦᱚᱲ ᱥᱟᱥᱟᱝ ᱨᱮᱦᱮᱫ ᱛᱟᱞᱟ ᱠᱷᱚᱱ ᱨᱟᱹᱯᱩᱫ ᱢᱮ᱾ ᱥᱟᱥᱟᱝ ᱵᱷᱤᱛᱤᱨ ᱦᱟᱹᱵᱤᱡ ᱯᱤᱭᱚᱨ-ᱱᱟᱨᱟᱝᱜᱤ ᱨᱚᱝ ᱛᱟᱦᱮᱸᱱᱟ, ᱚᱱᱟᱛᱮ ᱵᱷᱤᱛᱤᱨ ᱦᱚᱸ ᱵᱟᱦᱨᱮ ᱞᱮᱠᱟ ᱜᱮ ᱧᱮᱞᱚᱜ ᱞᱟᱹᱠᱛᱤᱭᱟ᱾ ᱯᱷᱤᱠᱟ ᱵᱷᱤᱛᱤᱨ ᱪᱮᱛᱟᱱ ᱨᱮ ᱢᱮᱨᱚᱢ ᱯᱤᱭᱚᱨ ᱪᱟᱢᱲᱟ ᱢᱮᱱᱮᱛᱮ ᱪᱮᱛᱟᱱ ᱨᱮ ᱨᱚᱝ ᱥᱮᱞᱮᱫ ᱟᱠᱟᱱᱟ ᱦᱩᱭ ᱫᱟᱲᱮᱭᱟᱜᱼᱟ᱾ ᱠᱟᱹᱵᱤᱡ ᱦᱚᱲ ᱠᱩᱠᱞᱤ ᱢᱮ, ᱥᱮ ᱚᱱᱟ ᱧᱮᱞ ᱦᱚᱪᱚ ᱢᱮ᱾
seg.3d4e366bb488.back: Break a dry turmeric root from the middle. Turmeric is yellow-orange colour until inside, so the inside too should look like the outside. A bright yellow skin on top of a pale inside means colour may have been added on top. Ask the seller, or get it checked.

seg.c62fa16e1d5f.back: Two tests which should be left out

seg.4c4dc95561d2.src: Iodine turns blue-black when it meets starch, and it is often suggested for spotting flour in turmeric. But turmeric is starchy itself, so it turns blue-black either way. That is why FSSAI's own manual uses the iodine test for powdered spices other than turmeric.
seg.4c4dc95561d2.t: ᱟᱭᱳᱰᱤᱱ ᱥᱴᱟᱨᱪ ᱥᱟᱶ ᱢᱤᱞᱟᱹᱣ ᱞᱮᱱᱠᱷᱟᱱ ᱞᱤᱞ-ᱦᱮᱸᱫᱮ ᱦᱩᱭᱩᱜᱼᱟ, ᱟᱨ ᱥᱟᱥᱟᱝ ᱨᱮ ᱟᱴᱟ ᱥᱮᱸᱫᱽᱨᱟ ᱞᱟᱹᱜᱤᱫ ᱟᱭᱢᱟ ᱫᱷᱟᱣ ᱠᱚ ᱞᱟᱹᱭᱟ᱾ ᱢᱮᱱᱠᱷᱟᱱ ᱥᱟᱥᱟᱝ ᱨᱮ ᱟᱡ ᱛᱮᱜᱮ ᱥᱴᱟᱨᱪ ᱢᱮᱱᱟᱜᱼᱟ, ᱚᱱᱟᱛᱮ ᱡᱟᱦᱟᱸ ᱞᱮᱠᱟ ᱜᱮ ᱞᱤᱞ-ᱦᱮᱸᱫᱮ ᱦᱩᱭᱩᱜᱼᱟ᱾ ᱚᱱᱟᱛᱮ ᱜᱮ FSSAI ᱨᱮᱭᱟᱜ ᱟᱡᱟᱜ ᱯᱚᱛᱚᱵ ᱟᱭᱳᱰᱤᱱ ᱴᱮᱥᱴ ᱥᱟᱥᱟᱝ ᱵᱟᱦᱨᱮ ᱮᱴᱟᱜ ᱦᱚᱞᱚᱝ ᱢᱚᱥᱞᱟ ᱞᱟᱹᱜᱤᱫ ᱵᱮᱵᱷᱟᱨᱟ᱾
seg.4c4dc95561d2.back: Iodine becomes blue-black when it meets starch, and many times people tell it for finding flour in turmeric. But turmeric itself has starch, so in any case it becomes blue-black. That is why FSSAI's own book uses the iodine test for other powder spices except turmeric.

seg.fc16ff8016e3.src: FSSAI's tests for lead, metanil yellow and chalk in turmeric use concentrated hydrochloric or sulphuric acid. These acids burn skin and eyes. They belong in a lab, not a kitchen.
seg.fc16ff8016e3.t: ᱥᱟᱥᱟᱝ ᱨᱮ ᱞᱮᱰ, ᱢᱮᱴᱟᱱᱤᱞ ᱤᱭᱮᱞᱚ ᱟᱨ ᱪᱚᱠ ᱞᱟᱹᱜᱤᱫ FSSAI ᱨᱮᱭᱟᱜ ᱴᱮᱥᱴ ᱠᱚ ᱠᱮᱴᱮᱡ ᱦᱟᱭᱰᱨᱚᱠᱞᱚᱨᱤᱠ ᱥᱮ ᱥᱟᱞᱯᱷᱤᱭᱩᱨᱤᱠ ᱮᱥᱤᱰ ᱵᱮᱵᱷᱟᱨᱟ᱾ ᱱᱚᱶᱟ ᱮᱥᱤᱰ ᱠᱚ ᱪᱟᱢᱲᱟ ᱟᱨ ᱢᱮᱫ ᱡᱚᱞᱟ᱾ ᱱᱚᱶᱟ ᱠᱚ ᱞᱮᱵ ᱨᱮᱭᱟᱜ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ, ᱡᱚᱢᱟᱜ ᱵᱮᱱᱟᱣ ᱚᱲᱟᱜ ᱨᱮᱭᱟᱜ ᱫᱚ ᱵᱟᱝ᱾
seg.fc16ff8016e3.back: FSSAI's tests for lead, metanil yellow and chalk in turmeric use strong hydrochloric or sulphuric acid. These acids burn skin and eyes. These are for the lab, not for the kitchen.

seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.src: For a sure answer: a food testing lab
seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.t: ᱯᱟᱠᱟ ᱛᱮᱞᱟ ᱞᱟᱹᱜᱤᱫ: ᱡᱚᱢᱟᱜ ᱧᱮᱞ ᱞᱮᱵ
seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.back: For a sure answer: food check lab

seg.1883beca4d73.src: A NABL-accredited food testing lab can test turmeric for lead and for added colours. Ask the lab how much sample it needs, keep the powder in its sealed pack or a clean sealed bag, and note the batch number printed on the pack. FSSAI publishes a list of notified food testing labs on its website.
seg.1883beca4d73.t: NABL ᱛᱮ ᱢᱟᱱᱚᱛ ᱟᱠᱟᱱ ᱡᱚᱢᱟᱜ ᱧᱮᱞ ᱞᱮᱵ ᱥᱟᱥᱟᱝ ᱨᱮ ᱞᱮᱰ ᱟᱨ ᱥᱮᱞᱮᱫ ᱨᱚᱝ ᱧᱮᱞ ᱫᱟᱲᱮᱭᱟᱜᱼᱟ᱾ ᱞᱮᱵ ᱴᱷᱮᱱ ᱠᱩᱠᱞᱤ ᱢᱮ ᱟᱡᱽᱦᱟᱨ ᱱᱚᱢᱩᱱᱟ ᱞᱟᱹᱠᱛᱤᱭᱟ, ᱦᱚᱞᱚᱝ ᱚᱱᱟᱨᱮᱭᱟᱜ ᱵᱚᱸᱫ ᱯᱮᱠ ᱨᱮ ᱥᱮ ᱥᱟᱯᱷᱟ ᱵᱚᱸᱫ ᱛᱷᱚᱞᱟ ᱨᱮ ᱫᱚᱦᱚ ᱢᱮ, ᱟᱨ ᱯᱮᱠ ᱨᱮ ᱪᱷᱟᱯᱟ ᱵᱮᱪ ᱱᱟᱢᱵᱟᱨ ᱚᱞ ᱫᱚᱦᱚ ᱢᱮ᱾ FSSAI ᱟᱡᱟᱜ ᱣᱮᱵᱥᱟᱭᱤᱴ ᱨᱮ ᱡᱚᱢᱟᱜ ᱧᱮᱞ ᱢᱟᱱᱚᱛ ᱞᱮᱵ ᱠᱚᱣᱟᱜ ᱛᱟᱹᱞᱤᱠᱟᱹ ᱪᱷᱟᱯᱟᱭᱟ᱾
seg.1883beca4d73.back: A food check lab approved by NABL can check lead and added colour in turmeric. Ask the lab how much sample is needed, keep the powder in its closed pack or a clean closed bag, and write down the batch number printed on the pack. FSSAI prints a list of approved food check labs on its website.

seg.456379c75c24.src: Read the pack before you buy

seg.ff7951e2f36b.src: An FSSAI licence or registration number. You can look it up on FSSAI's FoSCoS website.
seg.ff7951e2f36b.t: FSSAI ᱞᱟᱭᱥᱮᱱᱥ ᱥᱮ ᱨᱮᱡᱤᱥᱴᱨᱮᱥᱚᱱ ᱱᱟᱢᱵᱟᱨ᱾ ᱚᱱᱟ FSSAI ᱨᱮᱭᱟᱜ FoSCoS ᱣᱮᱵᱥᱟᱭᱤᱴ ᱨᱮ ᱥᱮᱸᱫᱽᱨᱟ ᱫᱟᱲᱮᱭᱟᱜᱼᱟᱢ᱾
seg.ff7951e2f36b.back: FSSAI licence or registration number. You can find it on FSSAI's FoSCoS website.

seg.476e4849c1d8.src: The name and address of whoever made or packed it.
seg.476e4849c1d8.t: ᱡᱤᱫᱤ ᱵᱮᱱᱟᱣ ᱥᱮ ᱯᱮᱠ ᱞᱮᱫᱟᱭ, ᱚᱱᱟᱭ ᱨᱮᱭᱟᱜ ᱧᱩᱛᱩᱢ ᱟᱨ ᱴᱷᱤᱠᱟᱹᱱᱟ᱾
seg.476e4849c1d8.back: Name and address of the one who made or packed it.

seg.beee8eda6466.src: Net quantity, MRP, a batch or lot number, and a best-before date.
seg.beee8eda6466.t: ᱵᱚᱡᱚᱱ, MRP, ᱵᱮᱪ ᱥᱮ ᱞᱚᱴ ᱱᱟᱢᱵᱟᱨ, ᱟᱨ best-before ᱢᱟᱦᱟᱸ᱾
seg.beee8eda6466.back: Weight, MRP, batch or lot number, and best-before date.

seg.f9270fd96202.src: Where it was grown. Turmeric from different regions differs in colour, so a named region helps you compare like with like.
seg.f9270fd96202.t: ᱚᱠᱟᱨᱮ ᱦᱟᱨᱟ ᱟᱠᱟᱱᱟ᱾ ᱟᱞᱟᱜ ᱟᱞᱟᱜ ᱴᱷᱟᱶ ᱨᱮᱭᱟᱜ ᱥᱟᱥᱟᱝ ᱨᱚᱝ ᱨᱮ ᱟᱞᱟᱜ ᱛᱟᱦᱮᱸᱱᱟ, ᱚᱱᱟᱛᱮ ᱴᱷᱟᱶ ᱧᱩᱛᱩᱢ ᱛᱟᱦᱮᱸ ᱞᱮᱱᱠᱷᱟᱱ ᱢᱤᱫ ᱞᱮᱠᱟᱱ ᱡᱤᱱᱤᱥ ᱥᱟᱶ ᱢᱤᱫ ᱞᱮᱠᱟᱱ ᱡᱤᱱᱤᱥ ᱡᱩᱲᱤ ᱫᱟᱲᱮᱭᱟᱜᱼᱟᱢ᱾
seg.f9270fd96202.back: Where it was grown. Turmeric of different places is different in colour, so if there is the place name you can compare a like thing with a like thing.

seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.src: Keep the pack zipped shut, or move the powder to a dry, airtight jar.
seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.t: ᱯᱮᱠ ᱨᱮᱭᱟᱜ ᱡᱤᱯ ᱵᱚᱸᱫ ᱫᱚᱦᱚ ᱢᱮ, ᱥᱮ ᱦᱚᱞᱚᱝ ᱨᱚᱦᱚᱲ, ᱦᱚᱭ ᱵᱚᱸᱫ ᱡᱟᱨ ᱨᱮ ᱫᱚᱦᱚ ᱢᱮ᱾
seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.back: Keep the pack's zip closed, or keep the powder in a dry, air-closed jar.

seg.bb4d61f86b55.src: Use a dry spoon. A damp spoon is what makes turmeric lumpy.
seg.bb4d61f86b55.t: ᱨᱚᱦᱚᱲ ᱪᱟᱢᱚᱪ ᱵᱮᱵᱷᱟᱨ ᱢᱮ᱾ ᱫᱟᱜ ᱢᱮᱱᱟᱜ ᱪᱟᱢᱚᱪ ᱛᱮ ᱜᱮ ᱥᱟᱥᱟᱝ ᱨᱮ ᱫᱤᱞᱟ ᱵᱮᱱᱟᱣᱚᱜᱼᱟ᱾
seg.bb4d61f86b55.back: Use a dry spoon. With a spoon that has water, lumps form in turmeric.

seg.a92c022ff52e.src: Keep it out of direct sunlight, which fades the colour.
seg.a92c022ff52e.t: ᱥᱤᱫᱷᱟ ᱥᱤᱛᱩᱝ ᱠᱷᱚᱱ ᱥᱟᱞᱟᱜ ᱫᱚᱦᱚ ᱢᱮ, ᱥᱤᱛᱩᱝ ᱨᱚᱝ ᱯᱷᱤᱠᱟᱭᱟ᱾
seg.a92c022ff52e.back: Keep away from direct sunlight, sunlight makes the colour pale.

seg.6911ce63edde.src: Is very bright yellow turmeric a bad sign?
seg.6911ce63edde.t: ᱟᱹᱰᱤ ᱢᱮᱨᱚᱢ ᱯᱤᱭᱚᱨ ᱥᱟᱥᱟᱝ ᱵᱟᱝ ᱵᱮᱥ ᱪᱤᱱᱦᱟᱹ ᱥᱮ?
seg.6911ce63edde.back: Is very bright yellow turmeric a not-good sign?

seg.a0ce62cee740.src: Not by itself. Colour changes with the variety, where it was grown and how it was dried and ground, so turmerics differ a lot. What matters is colour that leaves the powder too easily, as in the water check.
seg.a0ce62cee740.t: ᱮᱠᱮᱞ ᱚᱱᱟ ᱛᱮ ᱫᱚ ᱵᱟᱝ᱾ ᱨᱚᱝ ᱫᱚ ᱡᱟᱹᱛ, ᱦᱟᱨᱟ ᱴᱷᱟᱶ ᱟᱨ ᱪᱮᱫ ᱞᱮᱠᱟ ᱨᱚᱦᱚᱲ ᱟᱨ ᱯᱤᱥᱟᱣ ᱟᱠᱟᱱᱟ ᱚᱱᱟ ᱞᱮᱠᱟᱛᱮ ᱵᱚᱫᱚᱞᱚᱜᱼᱟ, ᱚᱱᱟᱛᱮ ᱥᱟᱥᱟᱝ ᱨᱮᱭᱟᱜ ᱨᱚᱝ ᱟᱹᱰᱤ ᱟᱞᱟᱜ ᱛᱟᱦᱮᱸᱱᱟ᱾ ᱧᱮᱞ ᱞᱟᱹᱠᱛᱤᱭᱟ, ᱦᱚᱞᱚᱝ ᱠᱷᱚᱱ ᱨᱚᱝ ᱟᱹᱰᱤ ᱟᱞᱜᱟ ᱛᱮ ᱚᱰᱚᱠᱚᱜ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ ᱥᱮ ᱵᱟᱝ, ᱫᱟᱜ ᱧᱮᱞ ᱨᱮ ᱞᱮᱠᱟ᱾
seg.a0ce62cee740.back: Not by that alone. Colour changes according to kind, growing place and how it has been dried and ground, so turmeric's colour is very different. What needs to be seen is whether colour comes out of the powder very easily or not, as in the water check.

seg.e8cc5edbb092.src: Can the water check show that turmeric has no lead?
seg.e8cc5edbb092.t: ᱫᱟᱜ ᱧᱮᱞ ᱛᱮ ᱥᱟᱥᱟᱝ ᱨᱮ ᱞᱮᱰ ᱵᱟᱹᱱᱩᱜᱼᱟ ᱢᱮᱱᱛᱮ ᱩᱫᱩᱜ ᱫᱟᱲᱮᱭᱟᱜᱼᱟ ᱥᱮ?
seg.e8cc5edbb092.back: Can it be shown with the water check that there is no lead in turmeric?

seg.37eb38df9ce8.src: No. Lead chromate does not dissolve in water, so the water check cannot see it. Only a lab test can.
seg.37eb38df9ce8.t: ᱵᱟᱝ᱾ ᱞᱮᱰ ᱠᱨᱚᱢᱮᱴ ᱫᱟᱜ ᱨᱮ ᱵᱟᱝ ᱞᱤᱞᱤᱭᱚᱜᱼᱟ, ᱚᱱᱟᱛᱮ ᱫᱟᱜ ᱧᱮᱞ ᱚᱱᱟ ᱵᱟᱝ ᱧᱮᱞ ᱫᱟᱲᱮᱭᱟᱜᱼᱟ᱾ ᱞᱮᱵ ᱴᱮᱥᱴ ᱜᱮ ᱧᱮᱞ ᱫᱟᱲᱮᱭᱟᱜᱼᱟ᱾
seg.37eb38df9ce8.back: No. Lead chromate does not dissolve in water, so the water check cannot see it. Only a lab test can see it.

seg.4c0bb3e9657c.back: Why do lumps form in turmeric?

seg.2b76cd3e665b.src: Moisture. A wet spoon or an open pack lets the powder take in water. Break the lumps with a dry spoon and keep the pack sealed.
seg.2b76cd3e665b.t: ᱫᱟᱜ ᱠᱷᱟᱹᱛᱤᱨ᱾ ᱫᱟᱜ ᱢᱮᱱᱟᱜ ᱪᱟᱢᱚᱪ ᱥᱮ ᱠᱷᱩᱞᱟᱹ ᱯᱮᱠ ᱛᱮ ᱦᱚᱞᱚᱝ ᱫᱟᱜ ᱦᱟᱛᱟᱣᱟ᱾ ᱫᱤᱞᱟ ᱨᱚᱦᱚᱲ ᱪᱟᱢᱚᱪ ᱛᱮ ᱨᱟᱹᱯᱩᱫ ᱢᱮ ᱟᱨ ᱯᱮᱠ ᱵᱚᱸᱫ ᱫᱚᱦᱚ ᱢᱮ᱾
seg.2b76cd3e665b.back: Because of water. With a spoon that has water or an open pack the powder takes water. Break the lumps with a dry spoon and keep the pack closed.

seg.87fe2929801d.src: What should I do if a check looks wrong?
seg.87fe2929801d.t: ᱡᱩᱫᱤ ᱢᱤᱫᱴᱟᱝ ᱧᱮᱞ ᱵᱷᱩᱞ ᱧᱮᱞᱚᱜ ᱠᱷᱟᱱ ᱪᱮᱫ ᱞᱟᱹᱠᱛᱤᱭᱟ?
seg.87fe2929801d.back: If a check looks wrong, what is needed?

seg.e83aba6cc6df.src: Stop using that batch, keep the pack, and contact the seller with the batch number. You can also report it to FSSAI through its Food Safety Connect app. If it is ours, WhatsApp us a photo of the pack and the glass.
seg.e83aba6cc6df.t: ᱚᱱᱟ ᱵᱮᱪ ᱵᱮᱵᱷᱟᱨ ᱵᱚᱸᱫ ᱢᱮ, ᱯᱮᱠ ᱫᱚᱦᱚ ᱢᱮ, ᱟᱨ ᱵᱮᱪ ᱱᱟᱢᱵᱟᱨ ᱥᱟᱶ ᱠᱟᱹᱵᱤᱡ ᱦᱚᱲ ᱥᱟᱶ ᱡᱚᱜᱟᱡᱚᱜ ᱢᱮ᱾ FSSAI ᱴᱷᱮᱱ ᱚᱱᱟᱨᱮᱭᱟᱜ Food Safety Connect ᱮᱯ ᱛᱮ ᱦᱚᱸ ᱞᱟᱹᱭ ᱫᱟᱲᱮᱭᱟᱜᱼᱟᱢ᱾ ᱡᱩᱫᱤ ᱟᱞᱮᱭᱟᱜ ᱠᱷᱟᱱ, ᱯᱮᱠ ᱟᱨ ᱜᱞᱟᱥ ᱨᱮᱭᱟᱜ ᱪᱤᱛᱟᱹᱨ ᱟᱞᱮ ᱴᱷᱮᱱ WhatsApp ᱠᱩᱞ ᱢᱮ᱾
seg.e83aba6cc6df.back: Stop using that batch, keep the pack, and contact the seller with the batch number. You can also tell FSSAI through its Food Safety Connect app. If it is ours, send a picture of the pack and glass to us on WhatsApp.

seg.1dd4194330b1.src: Try these checks on ours too. If anything looks off, ⟦1⟧WhatsApp us⟦/1⟧ a photo with the batch number from the pack.
seg.1dd4194330b1.t: ᱱᱚᱶᱟ ᱧᱮᱞ ᱠᱚ ᱟᱞᱮᱭᱟᱜ ᱥᱟᱥᱟᱝ ᱨᱮ ᱦᱚᱸ ᱧᱮᱞ ᱢᱮ᱾ ᱡᱩᱫᱤ ᱡᱟᱦᱟᱱ ᱵᱷᱩᱞ ᱧᱮᱞᱚᱜ ᱠᱷᱟᱱ, ᱯᱮᱠ ᱨᱮᱭᱟᱜ ᱵᱮᱪ ᱱᱟᱢᱵᱟᱨ ᱥᱟᱶ ᱪᱤᱛᱟᱹᱨ ⟦1⟧ᱟᱞᱮ ᱴᱷᱮᱱ WhatsApp ᱠᱩᱞ ᱢᱮ⟦/1⟧᱾
seg.1dd4194330b1.back: Do these checks on our turmeric too. If anything looks wrong, ⟦1⟧send us on WhatsApp⟦/1⟧ a picture with the pack's batch number.

seg.f803aad7e26d.src: Turmeric Adulteration Test at Home (Haldi, Pasupu) | 1acrefarms
seg.f803aad7e26d.t: ᱚᱲᱟᱜ ᱨᱮ ᱥᱟᱥᱟᱝ ᱢᱤᱥᱟᱹᱣ ᱧᱮᱞ (ᱦᱟᱞᱫᱤ, ᱯᱟᱥᱩᱯᱩ) | 1acrefarms
seg.f803aad7e26d.back: Checking turmeric mixing at home (Haldi, Pasupu) | 1acrefarms

seg.7d95509f17be.src: How to check turmeric powder (haldi, pasupu) at home: the water check, what it misses, why the iodine test does not work on turmeric, and when you need a lab.
seg.7d95509f17be.t: ᱚᱲᱟᱜ ᱨᱮ ᱥᱟᱥᱟᱝ ᱦᱚᱞᱚᱝ (ᱦᱟᱞᱫᱤ, ᱯᱟᱥᱩᱯᱩ) ᱪᱮᱫ ᱞᱮᱠᱟ ᱧᱮᱞ ᱞᱟᱹᱠᱛᱤᱭᱟ: ᱫᱟᱜ ᱧᱮᱞ, ᱚᱱᱟ ᱪᱮᱫ ᱵᱟᱝ ᱥᱮᱸᱫᱽᱨᱟ ᱫᱟᱲᱮᱭᱟᱜᱼᱟ, ᱟᱭᱳᱰᱤᱱ ᱴᱮᱥᱴ ᱥᱟᱥᱟᱝ ᱨᱮ ᱪᱮᱫᱟᱜ ᱵᱟᱝ ᱠᱟᱹᱢᱤᱭᱟ, ᱟᱨ ᱞᱮᱵ ᱛᱤᱥ ᱞᱟᱹᱠᱛᱤᱭᱟ᱾
seg.7d95509f17be.back: How turmeric powder (Haldi, Pasupu) should be checked at home: the water check, what it cannot find, why the iodine test does not work on turmeric, and when a lab is needed.

seg.d0950d598f8d.src: How to check turmeric powder at home · 1acrefarms
seg.d0950d598f8d.t: ᱚᱲᱟᱜ ᱨᱮ ᱥᱟᱥᱟᱝ ᱦᱚᱞᱚᱝ ᱪᱮᱫ ᱞᱮᱠᱟ ᱧᱮᱞ ᱞᱟᱹᱠᱛᱤᱭᱟ · 1acrefarms
